key_findings.tfidf_formal_suite_174k: All 8 TF-IDF representations PASS both frozen adversarial gates (LangDom < 0.85, JuristPairwise > 0.5) on exact k-NN stratified subsample. Production default cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 achieves best jurist preference (0.7265) with low language dominance (0.4895). HNSW artifact fix confirmed: exact k-NN on valid subset reveals true representation quality.
key_findings.v17b_generalization: v17b label normalization (15-25% gain at 1k scale) GENERALIZES to 174k with MASSIVE gains (5-10x). Raw legal_area labels (213) too sparse for meaningful clustering at 174k (purities 0.01-0.03). Normalized labels (111) restore meaningful clustering (purities ~0.16). Finding: label normalization ESSENTIAL for fine-grained legal_area evaluation at corpus scale.
